description_en: Queries the statistics of file systems that are owned by the current account
description_zh: 列出当前账号下文件系统的统计信息
name: DescribeFileSystemStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，每个分页包含的文件系统统计信息的个数。

取值范围：1~100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
列表的分页页码。

起始值（默认值）：1
parameters.name: page_number

FileSystemStatistic.description_zh: 文件系统的统计信息集合

ExpiredCount.description_en: The number of expired file systems
ExpiredCount.description_zh: 已到期的文件系统个数

ExpiringCount.description_en:
The number of expiring file systems.

File systems whose expiration time is less than or equal to seven days away from the current time are counted
ExpiringCount.description_zh:
即将到期的文件系统个数。

文件系统到期时间距离当前时间小于等于7天时将会被统计

FileSystemType.description_en: The type of the file system

MeteredSize.description_en:
The storage usage of the file system.

The value of this parameter is the maximum storage usage of the file system over the last hour.

Unit: bytes
MeteredSize.description_zh:
文件系统的使用量。

此参数非实时使用量，为上一小时的最大使用量。

单位：Byte

TotalCount.description_en: The number of file systems of the current type
TotalCount.description_zh: 当前类型的文件系统个数

Capacity.description_en:
The capacity of the file system.

Unit: GiB
Capacity.description_zh:
文件系统的容量。

单位：GiB

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method.

Valid values:

Subscription: The subscription billing method is used.
PayAsYouGo: The pay-as-you-go billing method is used.
Package: A storage plan is attached to the file system
ChargeType.description_zh:
计费类型。

包括：
Subscription：包年包月
PayAsYouGo：按量付费
Package：已绑定存储包

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the NAS file system was created
CreateTime.description_zh: NAS文件系统的创建时间。按照 ISO 8601 标准表示，并使用 UTC 时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Description.description_en: The description of the file system

ExpiredTime.description_en: The time when the file system expires
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 文件系统到期时间。按照 ISO 8601 标准表示，并使用 UTC 时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

FileSystemId.description_en: The ID of the file system

FileSystemType.description_en:
The type of the file system.

Valid values:

standard: General-purpose NAS file system
extreme: Extreme NAS file system
cpfs: CPFS file system
FileSystemType.description_zh:
文件系统类型。

包括：

standard：通用型NAS
extreme：极速型NAS
cpfs：CPFS

MeteredIASize.description_en:
The storage usage of the Infrequent Access (IA) storage medium.

Unit: bytes
MeteredIASize.description_zh:
低频介质存储用量。

单位：Byte

MeteredSize.description_en:
The storage usage of the file system.

The value of this parameter is the maximum storage usage of the file system over the last hour. Unit: bytes
MeteredSize.description_zh:
文件系统的使用量。

非实时使用量，为上一小时最大使用量，单位：Byte

ExpiredTime.description_en: The end time of the validity period for the storage plan
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 存储包到期时间。按照 ISO 8601 标准表示，并使用 UTC 时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

PackageId.description_en: The ID of the storage plan

Size.description_en: The capacity of the storage plan

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the validity period for the storage plan
StartTime.description_zh: 存储包起始时间。按照 ISO 8601 标准表示，并使用 UTC 时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

ProtocolType.description_en:
The protocol type of the file system.

Valid values:

NFS: Network File System (NFS)
SMB: Server Message Block (SMB)
cpfs: the protocol type supported by the CPFS file system
ProtocolType.description_zh:
文件系统协议类型。

包括：

NFS：NFS文件协议
SMB：SMB文件协议
cpfs：CPFS文件系统支持的协议类型

Status.description_en:
The status of the file system.

This parameter is returned for Extreme NAS file systems and Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS) file systems. Valid values:

Pending: The file system is being created or modified.
Running: The file system is available. Before you create a mount target for the file system, make sure that the file system is in the Running state.
Stopped: The file system is unavailable.
Extending: The file system is being scaled out.
Stopping: The file system is being disabled.
Deleting: The file system is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
文件系统状态。

极速型NAS和CPFS返回该字段，包括：

Pending：当前文件系统正在处理任务中。
Running：当前文件系统可用，当状态为Running时才可以进行后续操作（例如：创建挂载点等）。
Stopped：当前文件系统不可用。
Extending：当前文件系统扩容中。
Stopping：当前文件系统停机中。
Deleting：当前文件系统删除中

StorageType.description_en:
The storage type.

Valid values:

Valid values for General-purpose NAS file systems: Capacity and Performance.
Valid values for Extreme NAS file systems: standard and advance.
Valid values for CPFS file systems: advance_100 (100 MB/s/TiB baseline) and advance_200 (200 MB/s/TiB baseline)
StorageType.description_zh:
存储类型。

包括：

通用型NAS：Capacity（容量型）、Performance（性能型）
极速型NAS：standard（标准型）、advance（高级型）
CPFS：advance_100（100 MB/s/TiB基线）、advance_200（200 MB/s/TiB基线）

PageNumber.description_zh: 文件系统统计信息列表的分页页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每个分页包含的文件系统统计信息个数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of file system entries
TotalCount.description_zh: 文件系统的统计信息总数
